description: Create a new PayPal checkout order with a single purchase unit.

amount_value.description: The order amount as a string decimal (e.g. '49.99').

currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the amount (default 'USD').

payee_email.description: Email address of the merchant/payee receiving the funds.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the purchase unit.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created order object (id, intent, status, purchase_units, create_time).

description: Get a single checkout order by its id.

order_id.description: The unique id of the order.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the order object; on failure (order not found), output contains an error message.

description: Capture payment for an approved/created order, marking it COMPLETED.

order_id.description: The unique id of the order to capture.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the capture result with payments.captures; on failure (order not found, already captured, or voided), output contains an error message.

description: Create a refund against a prior capture, optionally for a partial amount.

capture_id.description: The id of the capture to refund.

amount_value.description: Optional refund amount as a string decimal; when omitted the full capture amount is refunded.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the refund amount (default 'USD').

note_to_payer.description: Optional note to the payer explaining the refund.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created refund object; on failure (capture not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single refund by its id.

refund_id.description: The unique id of the refund.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the refund object; on failure (refund not found), output contains an error message.

description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status, with pagination.

status.description: Optional invoice status filter (e.g. 'PAID', 'SENT', 'DRAFT'); matched case-insensitively.

page_size.description: Maximum number of invoices to return (default 20).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with total_items, total_pages, and items (list of invoices).

description: Create a new draft invoice for a recipient.

invoice_number.description: Optional invoice number; auto-generated (INV-XXXX) when omitted.

recipient_email.description: Email address of the invoice's primary recipient.

amount_value.description: The invoice amount as a string decimal (default '0.00').

currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the amount (default 'USD').

note.description: Optional note included on the invoice detail.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created invoice object with DRAFT status.

description: Create a single-item payout batch to a recipient.

amount_value.description: The payout amount as a string decimal (default '0.00').

currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the amount (default 'USD').

recipient_email.description: Email address of the payout recipient.

sender_batch_id.description: Optional sender batch id; auto-generated when omitted.

note.description: Optional email subject/note for the payout.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created payout object with batch_header and PENDING status.
